### His Nearness Is What I Needed
Author: Lauren Fletcher
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/his-nearness-is-what-i-needed-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 4:7
Points:
- Prayer is primarily about enjoying communion and experiencing God's presence, not merely seeking specific answers.
- In seasons of distress and uncertainty, the Lord makes His comforting presence tangible to His children.
- Moses reminds believers that God uniquely draws near to His people whenever they call on Him.
- Dwelling in God's nearness deepens our experiential knowledge of His compassion and fatherly love.

### Diligent Training
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobsons-parenting-devotional-mar-29.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 4:9
Points:
- Scripture charges parents with carefully remembering what they have seen and imparting it to their descendants.
- Guiding the spiritual development of children should be considered a parent's highest calling.
- Moses urges parents to discuss God's ways regularly and weave biblical truths into daily family life.
- Consistently modeling and teaching God's Word prepares the next generation to develop a vibrant faith.

### Witness the Work of God to your Children
Author: Glynnis Whitwer
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-8-2005-1334020.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 4:9
Points:
- Parents make God tangible to their children by sharing real-life testimonies of His faithfulness.
- Believers must intentionally watch themselves so God's past miracles do not fade from their hearts.
- Praying together and highlighting answered prayers shows children that God is actively listening.
- Pointing out God's hand in creation reinforces understanding of His eternal power and character.
- Recounting God's deeds serves as a powerful means to lead children into their own relationship with Him.
